metadata.title: माओवाद के ख़ात्मे के दावे और क़ीमत | The Cost of Claims to End Maoism | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: In this episode of Main Bhi Bharat, we are reporting from Bastar Art Café in Jagdalpur. As national headlines focus on recent developments in the region, we delve deeper to understand the ground realities of the anti-Maoist operations. With insights from three experts who have been working closely on the issues of Maoist violence, security operations, and the socio-economic conditions of Bastar, we explore what’s really happening on the ground—beyond the headlines.
